§3§lPurpose and operation§r
GTSWN provides wireless EU transfer for supported GT energy containers, grid monitoring, physical information screens and device status management, with ME quantum bridging through AE2.

§3§lChapter route§r
The §114§r quests cover the Wireless Energy Monitor, Portable Wireless Network Monitor, Link Terminal and covers, information screens, ME quantum networks and the Device Info Terminal. Start with a physical screen for EU trends, AE trends or AE inventory; carry its bound monitor to view the full screen remotely and select simplified entries for the HUD. The Device Info Terminal instead binds machines for an EU ledger, world labels, heat visualization and teleportation.

§3§lOperating requirements§r
Keep participating machine, screen and quantum-anchor chunks loaded. ME features require valid AE power and channel management. Crafting or item checks and manual checkboxes follow the individual quest requirements; reading a tutorial does not automatically verify its machine settings.
